text:
matt: heads up — after last night's log-reshard rollout (eu-west1) I'm not seeing trace_id joins for GPU-provision jobs in central kibana. spans exist in X-Ray but kibana queries return no matches for the same trace_id :eyes:

sophia: hmm, noticed a bunch of logs dropped from loki ingestion too. did ingest pipeline rotate the shard key?

jia: which timeframe? I can run a cross-check.

matt: window ~2023-11-02T03:10 -> 03:50 UTC. sample trace_id `trace-0a3f9c`. xray shows spans on host gpu-eu-22, but kibana returns nothing. loki shows `ingest_ok` for that pod though.

oliver: dropping in to say prometheus alerts started firing around 03:12 — `gpu-provision:5xx_rate` and `loki_ingest_errors_total` spiked. could be related.

noah: infra-bot reports shard-reshard job finished at 03:08, version v2.4.1, strategy=hash_by_request_id.

jia: running a loki query now to search by trace id label: `
{job="gpu-provision"} |= "trace-0a3f9c"` — will expand time range and include `trace_id` label search.

jia: query returned zero hits; raw logs for gpu-provision around 03:12 show entries with `req_id` but no `trace_id` label. suspect label extraction failed during pipeline re-bundle.

matt: that matches. X-Ray spans have `trace_id` in header but our log parser extracts `trace_id` via a grok rule that depends on `request_id` being present in the same payload. reshuffle might have changed message ordering.

oliver: can we re-run the parser against the retained raw logs? we keep raw JSON in cold-bucket for 30d. reindex would be slow but should restore correlation for past 2 hours.

noah: note: reindexing will create extra load on the hot-loki instance if we push too many batches. also it will re-trigger downstream alerts (SLO dashboards). need a throttled approach.

jia: quick probe — I ran a tail of the live loki push stream: saw messages being assigned `shard=20` while the parser expects `shard=request_hash%16`. mismatch there. config shows new shard_count=32 but parser config still assumes 16.

sophia: oh — deploy left parser config pinned to 16. operator error. new resharder set 32 to reduce hotspotting but forgot to update pipeliner.

matt: immediate mitigation: can we temporarily route gpu-provision logs to the legacy pipeline (shard=16) until we fix parser? config change is low-risk. who's on deploy?

oliver: I can flip a runtime flag to route `job=gpu-provision` -> legacy shard by mapping rule. will do rollback window 15m.

noah: I'll mute related prometheus alerts for that window: `gpu-provision:5xx_rate`, `loki_pipeline_errors`. add note in alert channel to avoid noise.

matt: thanks. post-mortem action items: 1) update parser grok to derive `trace_id` from alternative header order 2) sync shard_count across resharder + pipeliner 3) add a pre-deploy test that validates label extraction for a small sample 4) run reindex for 03:00-04:00 window to restore correlations (owner: jia)

jia: assigned. estimated reindex time ~45m throttled at 1000 msgs/s -> will pick off after we flip routing.

sophia: I'll open a PR to update the parser and add unit tests for shuffled fields.

oliver: routing flip in 2m. will confirm when done.

infra-bot: runtime-config-change: route_override applied by oliver at 2023-11-02T04:02:12Z (rule id r-79b).

oliver: routing flip complete. tail now shows `trace_id` labels reappearing for new logs.

noah: alerts muted. leaving a 15m backoff window.

matt: awesome. jia, kick off reindex when you have capacity and post progress here. we'll schedule follow-up postmortem doc. :thumbsup:
